# Churches of Christ in Aotearoa New Zealand Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L12 - Churches of Christ in Aotearoa New Zealand.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L12 - Churches of Christ in Aotearoa New Zealand
- Big idea: Local history should be documented from reliable evidence without treating movement history as the beginning of Christ's church.
- Primary reading: Acts 17:22-31; selected local historical sources

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
